svg.aria-label: Three layers. Ethereum mainnet at the base settles every position. Null sits on it and turns USDC into tokens: Receiver tokens that track assets such as AAPL, gold, the S&P 500 and BTC, and Payer tokens that take the other side. DeFi sits on top: Morpho, Uniswap, Aave, Sky and more can build with Null tokens for margin, lending, savings and collateral.
svg.title: Null as a building block
